question: In evidence.zip, Use the unique d31-- member whose basename ends .elf. Locate the unique CRC32-valid GRPH record by scanning backward from the end of the member. Its byte-4 version, byte-5 XOR key, little-endian length and CRC32 fields, XOR decoding, and UTF-8 JSON payload use the same 12-byte layout as HCFG. Submit the graph's unique leaf node: the node that is the source of no edge.

answer_format.syntax: exact case-sensitive artifact-derived text only; no quotes or explanatory text

generator_cmd: python3 cg_gen.py  # d30 members copied from the GM evidence; ELFs: gcc + stdlib struct/zlib record writer
oracle_cmd: ./cg_oracle.sh cg_synth.elf GRPH '[.nodes[] as $n | select([.edges[] | split("->")[0]] | index($n) | not) | $n] | .[0]'
